SddScope.keywords: scope, authoring, product, library, sdd-new, sdd-check
SddScope.Mission: Author one product/library scope from durable artifacts, not transcript memory. The autonomous route is skeleton → orient → fill → soft check → module handoff. The generated skeleton owns section format. Module/entity/DbC detail belongs to the module owner.

BeliefState.Axiom:
The SDD mechanical tools are `gennady` CLI commands. When working IN the gennady repo itself (including any worktree), the runner is `npx tsx /cli/gennady.ts`; in every other project it is `npx gennady`. Thus a Step's canonical `npx gennady ` fixes the command and arguments exactly; substitute only this runner when developing gennady itself, using the current worktree's root. Tools: `sdd-state`, `sdd-task`, `sdd-extract`, `sdd-verify`, `sdd-log`, `sdd-sync`, `sdd-check`, `sdd-new`, `sdd-migrate`, `sdd-orient`, `orient`, `lint`, `yagni`, `testcov`. A tool result is the named context of its producing Step; later Steps use it by Step ID and field, without reconstructing it. When a Step gives an exact call, run it as written — no `--help` or argument guessing. Run one CLI operation per tool call; never pipe/truncate its verdict, suppress stderr, compose a shell loop, or inspect CLI source to reinterpret it. An unusable result is a named tool-contract blocker, not permission for `rg`/`cat` archaeology. The calling Step states the exact command and arguments next to the action, then names which returned field/output becomes the next action's input. A failed invocation is retried only after a new hypothesis changes the command or underlying state; failure is never hidden with `|| true`. The `/sdd-*` skills (`/sdd-execute`, `/sdd-reconcile`, `/sdd-critic`, `/sdd-scaffold`) are not CLI tools — never prefix those with the CLI runner.
A validator verifies a completed mutation; it is not documentation or an authoring oracle. Never run `sdd-check` on a knowingly unfilled skeleton to discover what the manifest/format contract already states. Fill the artifact first, then run the owning Step's exact final check.

Step.Goal: Create the working artifact before reading optional protocols.
Step.Action: Classify the scope type and mode exactly once from the request and disk. Preserve the operator-confirmed `scale:` retained by this owner; must not reopen the already-settled route. Greenfield starts with exactly one applicable ToolCall. Existing specs are edited in place. npx gennady sdd-new product --scope Inputs : request scope classified in this step. Use productManifest. npx gennady sdd-new library --scope Inputs : request scope classified in this step. Use libraryManifest.

Step.Goal: Load only the bounded neighbouring context.
Step.Action: npx gennady sdd-orient --scope Inputs : scope resolved in STEP_0_CREATE. Use orientation. This is the only unconditional foreign-context read. Load interview-protocol, rule-registry, or research-gate only when the brief or orientation names their trigger. A brief that already names the consumer, happy path, negative path, constraints, and exclusions needs no interview.

Step.Goal: Replace skeleton guidance with the specification.
Step.Action: Fill each required section from its local comment and manifest; remove every consumed instructional comment. Record uncertain autonomous choices as one Decision Log line. Keep scope ownership thin. Do not preload structure, requirement, caption, or portal formats.

npx gennady sdd-check --spec --authoring Inputs : exact path from the STEP_0_CREATE manifest. Use draftReceipt. Apply only named hints to their sections, then rerun once for the final receipt. Never raise a draft time limit to compensate for reading. Do not run `sdd-check --all specs/` here: before module materialization it is guaranteed to report broken links.

ExecutionPlan.ScalePath: Continue directly into the module owner in the same pass. A small single-purpose scope normally becomes exactly one cohesive module. Treat the scope and module manifests as one authoring manifest; the scope owns its requirement IDs and the module cites them instead of copying them.

Step.Goal: Leave a checked actual scope/module set.
Step.Action: Route incomplete decomposition to module authoring. When an operator is actually present and explicitly requested interactive review, lazily `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/authoring-interactive.directive.xml")`. Autonomous authoring records deviations and continues without Approval/STOP ceremony.
